newsitem.title: ECUADOR: IMF officials review Ecuador's economic figures.
newsitem.headline: IMF officials review Ecuador's economic figures.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) officials Wednesday began meetings with Ecuador's Central Bank to review the country's macroeconomic performance, a Central Bank spokesman said.
Two IMF officials arrived Tuesday night in Quito to assess the economic plans of President Abdala Bucaram, said the spokesman, who asked not to be named.
The talks are to lay the groundwork for an IMF delegation due to arrive in two weeks.

Ecuador aims to sign a letter of intent this year with the IMF fixing macroeconomic targets for 1997 and is also seeking its endorsement to request the renegotiation of some $2 billion in debt with the Paris Club of creditor nations.
The visit of the officials coincides with the governement's preparations to send the 1997 budget bill to Congress.
